name: Terrarium 50x35x35
label: Medium terrarium
lead: Glass terrarium measuring 50x35x35 cm. Volume: 61.3 liters, horizontal format. Handmade in Novi Sad.

description.html: This 50x35x35 cm terrarium is the version without a 3D background: smooth glass, about 61 liters and 1750 cm² of floor, all of it usable. Cover on three sides comes from the outer decorative film. The front glass panels slide. The 35 cm width allows it to stand on an ordinary dresser.

For a leopard or fat-tailed gecko, half a meter of length means the warm and cool hides can be some thirty centimeters apart. A crested gecko will use the 35 cm height only if you offer it branches and leaves, because it is reluctant to stay on smooth glass with film on the outside. A corn snake grows here until its first or second year.

If you want relief on the back wall, the same model exists with a 3D background. For an adult corn snake you will later need 80 to 100 cm of length, for example the 80x40x45 or 100x40x40. You choose the film pattern before the build. A terrarium with changed dimensions is ready in 7 to 14 days and arrives by courier.
